title: Release channels and promotion rules under PR-ONLY release mode
question: Implement stable/beta/canary channels and the promotion path between them, where under the binding PR-ONLY owner decision a promotion is expressed as a pull request against the index rather than a direct write — and where an installed client can pin a channel.

enforcement: tools/marketplace/promotion.py:promote_via_pr mutates only a clone and returns a unified diff

stopping_condition_13.inline: Program stopping condition 13 ('release/canary succeeds') is unsatisfiable as written under PR-ONLY and is routed to the owner rather than silently redefined.
stopping_condition_13.promotion_module_inline: Program stopping condition 13 ('release/canary succeeds') is unsatisfiable as written under PR-ONLY and is routed to the owner rather than silently redefined.
stopping_condition_13.owner_route: Program stopping condition 13 ('release/canary succeeds') is unsatisfiable as written under PR-ONLY and is routed to the owner rather than silently redefined. A package-index canary channel is not a program canary deployment. CI install/upgrade/rollback rehearsal is REL-0003's question; IMP-0071 does not treat it as a substitute that satisfies condition 13.

implementation.client_pin: strict: resolve/install only versions whose channel equals the pin
implementation.promotion: PR diff against the index; zero direct writes
implementation.live_marketplace_json: absent on this worktree; this unit uses a fixture index and does not author a second live control plane (IMP-0067)

evidence.claim: A promotion attempt produces a PR diff artifact and performs zero direct index writes; index sha256 is unchanged before and after.
